capabilities: Convert DOCX, PDF, PPTX, XLSX, HWP, TXT, and CSV files to Markdown
Extract embedded images into vault asset folders and link them
Import files via drag-and-drop, command palette, or configured watch folders
Configure destination folders, filename collisions, and wikilink vs markdown links
Split PowerPoint decks into one note per slide or a single long-form note
extras: HWP/HWPx conversion is beta and hidden behind an advanced setting; no OCR, so scanned PDFs only produce a stub note; the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to import office document formats, so users must copy-paste and reformat content from Word, PDF, or slides by hand.

relations.evidence: The local-file companion to Confluence Weaver.

summary: Document converter that turns Word, PDF, PowerPoint, Excel, and HWP files into Markdown notes with extracted images and front matter.
